detail.longDescription: Today we are launching SIE Serverless - a managed inference product focused on small models. It’s useful for spiky workloads on 20+ task specific workloads across Search, OCR and Agentic execution. Sign up for a $500 credits launch grant after making an account :-) It’s powered by our open source inference engine that has received thousands of github stars in the last few months, battle-tested across finance, legal & tech. We believe that self-hosting is going to be critical given all the trust & security issues in AI, but practically there are always workloads where you’d like somebody else to deal with the GPU quota like synthetic data generation, evals, public research and beyond. The team at Superlinked has been burning the midnight oil for months and I’m so proud of every single one of you - what a privilege to call you my team mates y’all!
